_readme: Hand-curated mechanical effects for class-choice powers, merged on top of the auto-drafts by scripts/build_class_feature_changes.py (full replacement per power). Keys are normalized power names (lowercase, no (Su)/(Ex)/(Sp)). Entry keys: changes (always-on pf1 changes; for while-raging/while-mutagen powers the module toggles them with the parent state), contextNotes (situational text, every number in [[ ]]), conditionals (default-off weapon toggles {name, default, modifiers[]}; plain modifier formulas, riders in the name), tagBuff (Multi-Buff-Distributor payload {onlyOthers, auraRange, changes, contextNotes} for powers affecting OTHER creatures; @classes/@abilities refs are baked to the NPC's numbers at export). rogue_talents entries propagate automatically to ninja_talents/slayer_talents. core_features holds BASELINE chassis features (Smite Evil, Sneak Attack, ...); they have no scraped pool, so keys must match a classFeat item name in the module export every_class_feature.json (validator-enforced). Labeled variants like 'sneak attack (sla)' are separate entries because their progressions differ; the applier matches the raw item name before the label-stripped one.
